_governance.reason: assistant handwritten and search weak typing can only decrease
_governance.expires_when: all three buckets reach the irreducible serde/extension floor documented in assistant-runtime-foundation OPEN-003; anonymous string-keyed Maps outside those boundaries reach zero
_governance.measure: map_string_dynamic counts `Map<String, dynamic>` sites; map_string_object_optional counts `Map<String, Object?>` sites; bare_dynamic counts standalone `dynamic` sites with the dynamic Maps subtracted. The three buckets never count the same token. Comments are excluded.
_governance.superseded_measure: Two prior measures were retired. The original text-occurrence measure double counted every `Map<String, dynamic>` into a dynamic_keyword metric (baseline 209/373, of which 209 were duplicates) and had drifted to 292/522 without CI blocking it. Its replacement kept `Map<String, Object?>` as an informational metric with a stated target shape of `Map<String, Object?>`, which left a laundering channel open: a mechanical dynamic-to-Object? rewrite moved debt out of the ratchet without removing a single anonymous Map.
_governance.target_shape: metadata-owned named DTOs / sealed types generated from assistant contract schemas. `Map<String, Object?>` is not a target shape: it is only tolerated at serde boundaries (fromJson/toJson wire layer) and at contract-declared open extension slots, and that residue is locked by its own bucket

notes: Ratchet: any increase in map_string_dynamic, map_string_object_optional or bare_dynamic per bucket fails CI until baseline is intentionally updated.
